name: Critical Strike Shooter VR: SWAT Rescue
summary:
Gear up and dive into the ultimate VR tactical shooter. In Critical Strike Shooter VR: SWAT Rescue , you are the last line of defense between chaos and order. As a highly trained SWAT operative, every mission throws you into pulse-pounding hostage rescue operations, deadly ambushes, and explosive confrontations — all in stunning virtual reality.
